references.text: Moses gave instructions about the blessing and the curse that were to be read on Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim, which Joshua carries out here.
Contains the full blessings and curses from the Law of Moses that Joshua read aloud to the people.
Refers to the curses written in the Book of the Law, the same book Joshua read from.
Moses commanded that the law be read aloud to all Israel, which Joshua fulfills here.
Moses wrote the words of the law in a book, which is the same Book of the Law that Joshua reads from.
God commanded Joshua not to let the Book of the Law depart from his mouth, which he fulfills by reading the entire law aloud.
Ezra also read from the Law of Moses before the whole assembly, in a similar way to what Joshua did.
